intro: For Coach Myles, pitching starts in the mind. He coaches the mental side first — the sports psychology of competing on the mound — then builds clean mechanics and technique on that foundation. And every pitcher is different: styles, techniques, and coaching are tailored to the athlete.
arsenalNote: Different pitchers master different pitches and styles — every arsenal is built to the athlete. Here are the pitches Myles develops, and the kind of cues he coaches with.

arsenal.name: Fastball
arsenal.blurb: The foundation every other pitch plays off — command it first, built from the legs and forward.

arsenal.name: Two-Seam
arsenal.blurb: A movement fastball with late, heavy run.

arsenal.name: Changeup
arsenal.blurb: Mirrors the fastball's arm action so the hitter can't read it — kills timing.

arsenal.name: Cutter
arsenal.blurb: Looks like a fastball, breaks late — a true strikeout pitch.

arsenal.name: Knuckle Curve
arsenal.blurb: A breaking ball with depth, dropped into the zone for a called strike.

method.title: Mental game first
method.blurb: The foundation is sports psychology — composure, confidence, and focus on the mound. Every pitch is built on it.

method.title: Mechanics on a sound foundation
method.blurb: With the mental base set, Myles builds clean, repeatable mechanics and technique on top of it.

method.title: Built to the pitcher
method.blurb: Different pitchers master different styles. Every arsenal, technique, and cue is tailored to the individual athlete.

method.title: Film, reps & accountability
method.blurb: Game-film review, game-rep bullpens, and constant feedback — tough when it needs to be, encouraging every good rep.
